theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+2.60%) and Energy (+1.75%) led the market today, while Consumer Discretionary (-0.09%) and Health Care (-0.08%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +1.11%, defensives +0.12%, and value/cyclicals +0.74% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.58% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +0.48%. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.88%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 10.12% to 17.49, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 1.65% to $3,987.10, crude oil was little changed at $85.62, and bitcoin slipped 0.45% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
